description: This file defines the 'RegistrationEventQueue' class, which is an entity representing a queue of registration events in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like event type, timestamps, published status, and associated data, along with constants to identify event types and batch sizes.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueue
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing a queue of registration events, with properties for event details, timestamps, and data payload.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the registration event queue entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the registration event queue entry.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the registration event.

methods.name: setEventType
methods.description: Sets the type of the registration event.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the event has been published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the event.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event occurrence.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the event occurrence.

methods.name: getPublishTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: setPublishTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data payload associated with the event.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data payload associated with the event.
